fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-run-1x.png (297, 333, 1132, 209): graph node subtitles and connector conditions are too small to read comfortably at the displayed 80% zoom.
fixes.change: Set the displayed minimum size of node titles and subtitles to 12px with 16px line height, and connector labels to 11px with 16px line height. Apply these minimums after graph zoom; increase node padding to 12px horizontally and 8px vertically to contain the text.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-run-1x.png (1003, 420, 437, 43) and (297, 456, 140, 40): future and inactive graph nodes are dimmed until their labels and boundaries nearly disappear.
fixes.change: Set graph node and connector group opacity to 1. Use oklch(0.70 0.018 65) for secondary node text and oklch(0.40 0.016 60) for node borders. Preserve state distinctions with a 12px outlined state mark and explicit Pending or Not triggered text.

fixes.problem: Repeated faint supporting text: conversation (1204, 404, 35, 163), discussions (1218, 64, 200, 543), draft (521, 488, 664, 15), intake (291, 527, 395, 33), and run (296, 190, 158, 45), in their respective hercule-orient-express-*-1x.png images.
fixes.change: Set secondary text ink to oklch(0.70 0.018 65) at opacity 1 for timestamps, workspace labels, table metadata and explanatory footers. Verify a minimum 4.5:1 text contrast against each actual background.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-conversation-1x.png (1204, 404, 35, 163), hercule-orient-express-discussions-1x.png (1257, 158, 157, 99), and hercule-orient-express-draft-1x.png (521, 488, 664, 15): small metadata combines delicate strokes with limited size.
fixes.change: Use font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400 as the minimum metadata role for timestamps, discussion counts and workspace labels.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-conversation-1x.png (522, 275, 716, 59) and (522, 614, 716, 37): assistant prose repeatedly runs to approximately 100 characters per line.
fixes.change: Set assistant prose max-inline-size to 64ch and line-height to 22px. Measure the rendered result against the 60–75-character target.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-draft-1x.png (628, 331, 461, 17) and (650, 488, 112, 15): setup guidance uses worktree and remote default terminology without explaining the result plainly.
fixes.change: Replace the guidance with 'The agent starts in a new workspace, on a branch from the repository’s default branch.' Replace the branch-row label 'remote default' with 'Repository default branch'.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-intake-1x.png (924, 186, 203, 18): the branch value marta/webhook-backoff → main appears in the code face, contrary to the protected typeface roles.
fixes.change: Use the existing UI font family for branch values, at font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400.

summary: Hercule's warm palette and expressive colleague faces give the screens a coherent identity. Small, faint metadata is a repeated weakness, and the run graph has obstructive label sizing and dimming. The calibration and reference images are scored independently and produce no fixes.
